metadata.codeFormat: PSGC codes are 10-character numeric identifiers stored as strings; leading zeroes are significant.
metadata.scopeNote: Counts describe PSA source-level rows, not RECOVPH operations. Special grouping records and Manila SubMun records are reported separately from province, city, municipality, and barangay totals.

specialGroups.name: City of Isabela (Not a Province)
specialGroups.specialNote: PSA assigns the City of Isabela to Region IX through this special province code. It is not the Province of Basilan and is not itself a city-level record.

specialGroups.name: Special Geographic Area
specialGroups.specialNote: This coded aggregate groups eight PSA-listed municipalities and their barangays. It is not a province, city, or municipality.
